description: Intelligence V1.27 stored hazard-edit fixtures. Known dangerous (and a few known safe) proposals replayed through the real, unmodified deterministic chain with NO model, to exercise V1.11/V1.13/V1.16 safeguards independently of model behavior (V1.23 limitation: the model proposed none of the hazard edits). Expected dispositions come from the documented rules, not from observed output. Texts are disjoint from the frozen benchmark.

fixtures.text: he stood trial for an offence under section four two zero IPC
fixtures.rationale: Altering the number inside an applied statutory provision is forbidden outright, not even review-only.

fixtures.text: the complaint alleged an offence under section three seven six BNS
fixtures.rationale: Same shape, different statute and number.

fixtures.text: the complainant's version was not accepted by the court.
fixtures.rationale: Removing an intra-token apostrophe is demoted to review-only by the V1.16 gate (gate rules P-A routine-punctuation allowlist and/or P-B no intra-token change; both apply).

fixtures.text: The s/o column was left blank in the form.
fixtures.rationale: Removing an intra-token slash is demoted by the gate (gate rules P-A routine-punctuation allowlist and/or P-B no intra-token change; both apply).

fixtures.text: Narayan Tripathy testified for the defence.
fixtures.rationale: Merging a two-word name is demoted by the gate (W-A1).

fixtures.rationale: Merging a two-word name is demoted by the gate (W-A1).

fixtures.text: Exhibit D14 was marked in evidence.

fixtures.text: The fine of Rs. 2,500 was deposited.

fixtures.rationale: Same shape for a date.
